title: Follow-up request that relies on the previous change

steps.request: Add a removeStock(inventory, sku, qty) function to lib/inventory.js that takes stock away, with tests.

Follow-up on the function you just added: removing more than is in stock must throw an InsufficientStockError (export it; it needs sku, requested and available properties) and leave the stock unchanged. Removing zero or a negative quantity should throw a RangeError. Update the tests.

acceptance: Step 1: removeStock reduces stock; tests pass
Step 2: InsufficientStockError (exported, with sku/requested/available), stock unchanged on error, RangeError for qty ≤ 0
Step-1 behaviour still works after step 2
